s.t:
Eightfold is a global leader in an AI-native enterprise talent platform , trusted by the world’s largest & most respected Fortune 500 organizations.

Our platform is built from the ground up, operating at scale across Azure and AWS, deployed in multiple regions globally, including IL4-compliant environments for the US Government, supporting users in 100+ countries and 30+ languages.

Today, Eightfold is at the forefront of agentic AI, delivering intelligent agents that actively drive outcomes across hiring and talent workflows, while much of the industry is still experimenting with prototypes. Backed by over $410M in funding and valued at $2B+, we are defining the next era of agentic talent systems.
What sets Eightfold apart is not just the technology & our mission, but the team behind it. We are a deeply technical, execution-driven organization that values ownership, collaboration, and high standards.

Our engineers, product leaders, and go-to-market teams work closely together — in person and across functions — to build systems that scale in the real world. If you’re excited to work on hard problems, move with urgency, raise the bar every day, and help build agentic systems that transform how the world works, Eightfold is the place to do it.

The Sr. Client Partner is a senior individual contributor within the Solution Delivery - Service Sales organization responsible for driving services revenue, solution strategy, and implementation readiness across complex enterprise customer engagements.
As a trusted advisor to customers and internal stakeholders, the Sr. Client Partner partners closely with Sales, Solution Delivery, Customer Success, Alliances, Finance, and Legal teams to develop implementation strategies that accelerate customer value realization while supporting Eightfold’s growth objectives.
The Sr. Client Partner owns the full professional services sales lifecycle from discovery and solution strategy through estimation, Statement of Work (SOW) creation, commercial negotiation, and deal closure. This role ensures that services engagements are strategically aligned, commercially sound, operationally executable, and positioned to achieve successful customer outcomes.
As one of the most experienced members of the Services Sales organization, the Sr. Client Partner also provides mentorship, guidance, and subject matter expertise to peers while contributing to the evolution of services offerings, sales processes, and go-to-market strategy.

Professional Services Sales & Solution Strategy
Lead the Services sales process for new customer implementations, expansions, and transformation initiatives.
Partner with Account Executives and customers to develop implementation strategies that support business objectives and product adoption.
Facilitate discovery sessions to understand customer requirements, operating models, technical environments, and success criteria.
Translate business and technical requirements into scalable implementation approaches and services solutions.
Position Solution Delivery as a strategic enabler of customer outcomes and long-term platform value.
Statement of Work (SOW) Development & Commercial Ownership
Own the development, authoring, review, and negotiation of Statements of Work (SOWs) for customer engagements.
Define project scope, assumptions, deliverables, milestones, implementation approach, staffing models, and success criteria.
Develop effort estimates, resource plans, pricing models, and commercial structures that balance customer value, delivery feasibility, and profitability objectives.
Lead services-related contract discussions and partner with Legal, Procurement, and customer stakeholders through negotiation and execution.
Manage scope alignment throughout the sales cycle and ensure smooth transition into delivery.
Support change requests and scope modifications as customer needs evolve.
Deal Strategy & Cross-Functional Leadership
Serve as the primary Services Sales advisor for strategic opportunities and complex enterprise deals.
Partner with Solution Delivery leaders to validate implementation approaches, staffing assumptions, and execution readiness.
Collaborate with Customer Success teams to identify adoption risks, expansion opportunities, and services-led value acceleration initiatives.
Support partner-led and co-delivered engagements through joint planning, solution validation, and services strategy alignment.
Act as a trusted advisor to internal stakeholders throughout the deal lifecycle.
Forecasting, Financial Performance & Operational Excellence
Maintain accurate services pipeline, bookings forecasts, and opportunity tracking within CRM systems.
Drive forecast accuracy through disciplined opportunity management and proactive risk identification.
Ensure engagements align with pricing guidelines, margin targets, and business objectives.
Partner with Finance and Delivery leadership to provide visibility into services demand, resource requirements, and revenue forecasts.
Identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency, sales effectiveness, and commercial consistency.
Services Innovation & Organizational Impact
Contribute to the development of packaged services offerings, implementation accelerators, and scalable delivery models.
Provide feedback and market insights that influence Solution Delivery strategy and go-to-market priorities.
Mentor Client Partners and contribute to the development of services sales best practices.
Support onboarding, enablement, and knowledge sharing across the Services Sales organization.
Participate in strategic initiatives designed to improve forecasting, service offerings, sales tools, methodologies, and customer outcomes.

8+ years of experience in enterprise software, SaaS, consulting, professional services sales, solution consulting, or implementation services.
Proven track record selling and negotiating complex Professional Services engagements in enterprise environments.
Extensive experience creating and negotiating Statements of Work, project scopes, pricing structures, and commercial agreements.
Strong understanding of implementation methodologies, enterprise software deployments, systems integration, and customer transformation programs.
Excellent executive communication, presentation, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills.

Experience supporting HCM, Talent Acquisition, Talent Management, HR Technology, AI, or Enterprise SaaS solutions.
Experience working with partner-delivered implementation models and global systems integrators.
Consulting background with a leading systems integrator, enterprise software company, or management consulting firm.
Experience selling or contracting within U.S. federal, state, or local government environments, including familiarity with government procurement processes, compliance requirements, and public sector implementation programs.
We are a team of self-starters who excel in their fields. We believe in giving you responsibility, not a task. We want you to have ownership and pride in your work and see your work's positive impact on your colleagues, our customers, and the world. We believe in providing transparency and support so you can do the best work of your career.

🚀 Key Account Executive (Outbound) (m/w/d) – Berlin (Vor Ort)
Bereit für den nächsten Schritt im Vertrieb bei einem der am schnellsten wachsenden FinTechs weltweit?
Werde Teil unseres ambitionierten Teams in Berlin und unterstütze kleine Unternehmen im gesamten DACH-Markt mit modernen Payment- und POS-Lösungen.

Verantwortung für den gesamten Sales Cycle – von der ersten Kontaktaufnahme bis zum erfolgreichen Vertragsabschluss.

Durchführung strukturierter Discovery- und Beratungsgespräche, um die Anforderungen der Kunden zu verstehen und passende Payment-, POS- und Kiosklösungen zu empfehlen.
Durchführung überzeugender Produktpräsentationen und Demos.
Souveräner Umgang mit Einwänden sowie Gespräche auf Entscheider- und Geschäftsführerebene.
Enge Zusammenarbeit mit internen Teams wie Sales Enablement und Product.
Analyse deiner Performance, Erreichen deiner Ziele und kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung anhand von Daten und Feedback.
Aktive Mitgestaltung einer leistungsorientierten Outbound-Vertriebskultur in unserem Berliner Büro.

Erfahrung in der Kaltakquise, Leadgenerierung und dem Aufbau einer Sales Pipeline.
Beratungsorientierter Vertriebsansatz sowie die Fähigkeit, komplexere Kundenanforderungen zu verstehen und passende Lösungen zu entwickeln.
Deutsch auf C2- oder muttersprachlichem Niveau sowie gute Englischkenntnisse.
Ausgeprägte Eigenmotivation, Hunter-Mentalität und hohe Eigenverantwortung.
Begeisterung für Technologie, Payment-Lösungen und die Zusammenarbeit mit Unternehmern.

Attraktives Fixgehalt plus ungedeckelte Provision – dein Erfolg bestimmt dein Einkommen.
Die Möglichkeit, bei einem schnell wachsenden globalen FinTech echten Einfluss zu nehmen.
Eine Office-First-Kultur in unserem Berliner Büro mit einem motivierten und internationalen Team.
2.000 € jährliches Weiterbildungsbudget für Kurse, Zertifizierungen und Workshops.
30 Tage Sabbatical nach drei Jahren Betriebszugehörigkeit.

Wenn du im Outbound-Vertrieb erfolgreich sein möchtest, gerne Verantwortung übernimmst und Teil eines schnell wachsenden FinTechs werden willst, freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung.

Do you want the challenge — and the reward — of building your own book of business? At Keycafe , we’re looking for an Account Executive who thrives on creating new opportunities, closing deals, and owning an entire territory or industry segment.

This isn’t account management or order processing — it’s a chance to be entrepreneurial inside a growing SaaS/IoT company and essentially build a business of your own. What You’ll Do Own a market — you will be focused on the UAE / Middle East market, and you’ll be responsible for growing our top segments as if it were your own business.

Run high-impact demos that clearly show prospects how our SmartBox product solves their operational challenges. Drive the full sales cycle: prospecting, outreach, demos, negotiation, and close. Experiment and adapt — try new outreach methods, refine your pitch, and find creative ways to break through.

Collaborate across teams to ensure smooth handoffs and long-term customer success. Why Join Keycafe Entrepreneurial ownership: AEs at Keycafe own entire industries or countries, giving you the chance to build your own business line inside the company.

Global impact: Our SmartBox is trusted by customers worldwide, from small businesses to large organizations. Startup culture with reach: Be part of a fast-growing SaaS/IoT company where your ideas matter and your success is highly visible.

About Keycafe Keycafe , headquartered in Vancouver and with a team spanning the globe, powers secure and seamless key management for businesses worldwide. Our SmartBox system combines IoT hardware with cloud software to give organizations total control over their keys — anytime, anywhere.

From hospitality and property management to logistics, fleets, and government, companies rely on Keycafe to keep operations secure, efficient, and scalable. Requirements Who You Are 2+ years of B2B SaaS or high-velocity sales experience with a track record of consistently closing new business.

A self-starter who’s energized by ownership — you don’t just run plays, you create them. Resilient and resourceful — you keep moving after rejection and find new ways to win. Passionate about learning products and showing customers how they can transform operations.

Startup-minded — flexible, collaborative, and willing to contribute beyond your immediate role. Nice to Have Sales experience in industries like hospitality, property management, fleet/logistics, facilities/security, first responder, or government services. Background in IoT, access control, or hardware-enabled SaaS.

Benefits Base salary $40,000 - $55,000 USD plus uncapped commission, expected OTE $80,000 - $95,000 USD. Remote-friendly with flexibility to own your territory or industry. Opportunity to build and grow your own business line within a scaling SaaS/IoT company. Work with a tangible, innovative product already trusted by businesses worldwide.

Career growth and visibility — your success is highly visible in a company where results matter. Originally posted on Himalayas

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT.

Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles.

Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.
Global System Integrators (GSI) play a crucial role in Canonical growth plans in the coming 3 years. We are hiring a Senior Partner Sales Manager to work closely with Canonical GSI partners throughout their sales cycles and across their sales organizations to facilitate Ubuntu based solutions and opportunities, as well as help GSI build long term digital transformation platforms with Ubuntu stacks and services.
Working the the Partner Sales Director in their geographic region, the Senior Partner Sales Manager will be responsible for building trusted relationships with partners, increasing Canonical market share and attach rate, evangelizing about the partnership and leading all business interactions from engineers to CxO level.

They will often run customer workshops focused on particular initiatives at that customer, attend sales events, give public presentations and participate in executive engagements as coordinated by the Senior Director.

Build strategic relationships with partners at levels, and stickiness with Ubuntu technology
Deep understanding of Linux and cloud software ecosystem, and open source selling models
Negotiate contracts and commercial business terms
Deep understanding of partner organizations and sales models, in particular with Global System Integrators
Work closely with marketing, sales engineering and product management to deliver on targets, objectives and provide a voice of the partner
Lead executive interlocks between partners and Canonical leadership team
Ability to travel - sometimes internationally - up to 40% of the time

s.h: What we are looking for in you
s.t:
Extensive experience in alliance or indirect sales management roles
Extensive experience with OpenStack, virtualization, containers and other Cloud technologies.
Autonomous, disciplined, hands-on, get-it-done mentality
Ability to capture customer requirements, evaluate gaps, identify and create opportunities
Passionate about Ubuntu products and mission
Comfortable in fast-paced and high pressure environments with ambitious achievement goals
Excellent communication and presentation skills

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year

Recognition rewards
Annual holiday leave
Maternity and paternity leave
Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company.

We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Pacvue is the leading Commerce Media OS, powering over $12B in advertising spend across 100+ global retail media networks including Amazon, Walmart, Target, Kroger, Instacart, Criteo, and CitrusAd.

Powered by industry-leading AI and real-time data, Pacvue enables over 70,000 brands and agencies to maximize advertising performance, drive incrementality, and expand reach across the commerce universe from a single mission control. As of 2025, Pacvue powers 12% of total retail media ad spend worldwide excluding China.

Combined with Helium 10’s SMB solutions, Pacvue delivers the industry’s most comprehensive platform for businesses of all sizes.

At Pacvue and Helium 10, great careers don’t just happen — they’re built. Here, you’ll rise as an industry leader, push the boundaries of innovation, own your journey, and thrive as part of an inclusive global community that’s redefining the future of commerce.

As an Account Manager, Enterprise Partnerships at Pacvue, you will support the day-to-day management of client accounts across a portfolio of European agency clients, primarily independent Amazon and ecommerce agencies, and ecommerce brands with growing exposure to enterprise-level retailers such as Amazon and other regional platforms.

This role will involve working closely with internal team members and client stakeholders across multiple European markets to help execute partnership plans, ensuring clients achieve success through our platform while supporting overall revenue goals for Pacvue.

You will be expected to leverage your analytical skills, communication abilities, and insights to assist with client outcomes and support ongoing account activities in a dynamic, fast-growing international environment, and using data to tell the story.

· Own the end-to-end success of assigned European client portfolio. Make independent decisions on strategy, performance management, and client communications with only critical decisions reviewed. Accountable for revenue growth, client retention, and regional market outcomes.

· Build and nurture partnerships that support client success and contribute to Pacvue’s regional revenue growth.

· Act as a supporting consultant to clients, offering guidance on eCommerce best practices, marketplace dynamics, and performance optimization across European platforms.

· Analyze client data across multiple European marketplaces to uncover insights and opportunities for improvement, leveraging Pacvue's platform to recommend solutions aligned with client business objectives.

· Lead strategy sessions with clients, independently determining the approach to localized eCommerce strategies. Make autonomous decisions on optimization priorities, regional tactics, and resource allocation, with oversight only at critical milestones.

· Independently identify, evaluate, and execute upsell and cross-sell opportunities within assigned accounts by assessing client data, market conditions, and product fit. Devise solutions and strategies with minimal senior oversight.

· Collaborate across Sales, Customer Success, Product, and Marketing teams as a strategic advisor on client needs and market opportunities. Influence team priorities based on regional market insights; may mentor junior team members on account strategy.

· Collaborate with senior team members to align client objectives with Pacvue’s product roadmap, incorporating regional market insights and needs.

· Regularly track and report on client performance across European markets, providing analysis and actionable recommendations to drive improved results.

· Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs), using data insights to proactively suggest adjustments to strategies, channel mix, or regional approaches.

· Support the preparation and delivery of presentations to senior stakeholders, including those tailored to regional audiences.

· Be a passionate advocate for client success within Pacvue, ensuring their needs are met across different markets and business environments.

· Continuously identify ways to help clients maximize the value of Pacvue’s tools and technology to enhance their eCommerce advertising results across European platforms.

· Support renewal and expansion efforts by identifying opportunities and collaborating with senior team members on execution.

· 5+ years of experience in Account Management, Client Success, or Consulting roles within eCommerce, digital advertising, or SaaS environments, with demonstrated mastery of marketplace dynamics and client strategy.

· Experience supporting client relationships, including exposure to larger or enterprise accounts, ideally within European markets.

· Experience contributing to team-based revenue or client growth goals.

· Advanced analytical professional with deep expertise in eCommerce platform dynamics, marketplace strategy, and data interpretation. Independently interprets complex, multi-variable data across European markets to extract strategic insights and drive client outcomes.

· Fluent German and English, C1 or C2 level at a minimum.

· Exceptional communication and presentation skills, with the ability to effectively engage stakeholders across different regions; additional European language skills (e.g., French or German) are a plus.

· Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to prioritize and manage multiple competing priorities.

· A strategic thinker who can identify opportunities for growth and improving client outcomes within regional contexts.

· Comfortable working in a fast-paced, dynamic, and multicultural environment.

Trusted Shops – We build trust.
Our mission is to make online shopping safer and more reliable by connecting trustworthy online shops with over 40 million European consumers in our Community of Trust . More than 30,000 businesses across Europe use our solutions to build trust in their digital services and products. Whether it’s authentic reviews, buyer protection, or legal tech solutions – our tools help brands create transparency, reduce uncertainty, and attract new customers. In short: no more fakes .

As a Senior Sales Manager, y ou'll put your SaaS, digital marketing, and e-commerce know-how to work where it counts: winning new business and driving real B2B sales results. With a sharp focus on acquiring new customers and a structured approach to the sales cycle, you’ll play a key role in fueling our company’s growth.

Engaging with clients across a wide range of industries, you’ll confidently introduce our platform to mid-sized and high growth businesses - helping them unlock their full growth potential.

s.h: Your Mission: Drive Growth. Build Trust. Close Deals.
s.t:
Understand customer needs by analyzing their business challenges – and use AI-driven insights to present tailored, value-adding solutions.
Own the full new business cycle – from identifying and approaching qualified leads to closing deals and handing over seamlessly to our Account Management team.
Expand your reach through cold calling, email outreach, LinkedIn networking, event participation, and other prospecting channels.
Manage a strong pipeline of qualified leads and opportunities, ensuring consistent momentum and measurable results.
Pitch our SaaS solutions to mid-sized and high growth businesses across various industry verticals – via video calls, phone, email, or on-site meetings when needed.
Collaborate cross-functionally with marketing, partnerships, account management, and customer success to deliver a customer-first experience and help shape a digital world people can trust.
Engage e-commerce decision-makers and build compelling cases for partnering with Trusted Shops.
Actively contribute to lead definition, qualification, and acquisition – bringing your insights and creativity to the table.
3+ years of sales experience in the SaaS industry or in selling complex, consultative digital products or software solutions.
Deep understanding of e-commerce platforms and a strong grasp of the SaaS landscape – you know the market and the players.
Proven track record in sales , with experience managing diverse deals and stakeholders across the pipeline – from mid-sized clients to fast-growing enterprises.
Proactive and results-driven mindset – you're motivated by success, learn from setbacks, and continuously strive to improve.
Exceptional communication skills , quick thinking, and a strategic approach to navigating complex sales conversations.
Collaborative team player , able to work effectively with internal teams and build strong relationships with prospects and clients.

Job Description
Senior Sales Account Manager | Glasgow, Scotland
Do you have the commercial insight and relationship-building skills to become a trusted partner to some of Scotland’s most important energy organisations?
GE Vernova is looking for an exceptional Senior Sales Account Manager to join our Grid Solutions – Grid Systems Integration team, with Glasgow as the strongly preferred location.
--------------------------------------------------------------------
GE Vernova – The Energy to Change the World
With over 130 years of experience and proven innovation, GE Vernova is leading a new era of energy. We are electrifying the world while working to decarbonise it.
Our name reflects our mission. “GE” carries a legacy of quality and ingenuity. “Ver” signals Earth’s lush ecosystems, while “Nova” represents the new era of lower-carbon energy we are helping to deliver.
Focused on the future, GE Vernova is accelerating the shift to reliable, affordable and sustainable energy. We help customers power economies and deliver electricity that is vital to health, safety and quality of life.
--------------------------------------------------------------------
Electrification
Our Electrification solutions modernise grids, enable renewable integration and strengthen energy systems. From grid technologies and software to power conversion and storage, we help create smarter, more resilient energy networks.
Within Grid Solutions, our Grid Systems Integration business delivers complete high-voltage alternating current and direct current solutions, including engineering, procurement and associated construction services. These range from individual infrastructure upgrades to major, complex programmes worth hundreds of millions of pounds.
--------------------------------------------------------------------

As Senior Sales Account Manager, you will lead and develop our strategic customer relationships across Scotland, positioning GE Vernova as a trusted long-term partner to utilities, developers, industrial organisations and emerging energy customers.
Reporting to the Grid Systems Integration North & South Europe Commercial and Tendering Leader, you will build relationships with senior and executive-level stakeholders, understand customers’ long-term investment priorities and translate their needs into commercially viable opportunities.
You will work closely with Sales, Tendering, Engineering, Commercial Operations, Marketing and wider regional teams to shape customer strategies, develop opportunities and align the organisation around customer requirements.
This is a newly created individual contributor role, providing dedicated commercial leadership for Scotland. You will have the opportunity to shape GE Vernova’s strategic account approach within the market while leading through influence across a complex, international organisation.
--------------------------------------------------------------------
How You Will Make a Difference
Build and maintain trusted relationships with senior and executive-level stakeholders across Scottish utilities and other strategic customers.
Develop and implement account and sales plans that support profitable growth, pipeline development, order intake and long-term market positioning.
Understand customers’ electrification, grid resilience, sustainability and decarbonisation priorities and translate them into opportunities for GE Vernova.
Act as a strategic adviser to customers, connecting their operational and investment needs with relevant technical and commercial solutions.
Map customer organisations, identifying decision-makers, influencers, supporters and potential barriers to successful engagement.
Develop relationship strategies that strengthen GE Vernova’s position and improve customer satisfaction, trust and advocacy over time.
Identify opportunities to grow existing accounts and establish relationships with new customers across utilities, renewable-energy development, industry, data centres and other emerging sectors.
Conduct market and customer analysis to identify future investment programmes, regulatory developments and new business opportunities.
Coordinate internal technical, commercial and operational teams around customer needs throughout the opportunity lifecycle.
Shape competitive customer solutions and support the development of major bids and proposals alongside Sales and Tendering colleagues.
Support commercial and contractual negotiations, helping to secure appropriate commercial terms, governance and risk mitigation.
Identify and support strategic partnerships and alliances that strengthen GE Vernova’s ability to deliver competitive and profitable solutions.
Manage the customer relationship from initial engagement and onboarding through opportunity development, delivery relationships, repeat business and renewals.
Maintain accurate account plans, customer activity, opportunity pipelines and forecasts using Salesforce.
Provide regular insights and recommendations on account performance, customer priorities, market developments and future opportunities.
Represent GE Vernova at customer meetings, industry events, conferences and networking forums across Scotland.
Comply with Grid Solutions Sales and Tendering processes, Delegation of Authority requirements, the GE Vernova Code of Ethics and all applicable environmental, health and safety standards.
--------------------------------------------------------------------
Skills for Success
You will be a confident relationship-builder with strong commercial judgement and the ability to align teams around customer priorities without relying on direct reporting authority.

Significant experience in strategic B2B account management, business development or complex solution sales.
Experience within energy, utilities, grid infrastructure, industrial solutions, cleantech or another relevant technical market.
A strong track record of building and developing relationships with senior and executive-level stakeholders.
The ability to understand complex customer challenges and translate them into clear account strategies and commercial opportunities.
Experience managing long-term, high-value or technically complex sales opportunities.
Strong commercial judgement, with experience supporting negotiations, contractual discussions and risk management.
Excellent stakeholder management, presentation, communication and negotiation skills.
The ability to lead and influence multifunctional teams across a matrix organisation.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to turn customer and market insight into practical action plans.
Experience using Salesforce or a comparable customer relationship management platform.
Fluent written and spoken English.
A bachelor’s degree or equivalent knowledge and experience in engineering, business, commercial management or a related discipline would be valuable. We are, however, most interested in the overall experience, market understanding and professional achievements you would bring to the role.
Experience working with Scottish utilities, transmission or distribution network operators would be a strong advantage. Knowledge of high-voltage transmission solutions, including HVAC, HVDC, substations, grid stability technologies or major EPC infrastructure projects, would also be beneficial.

This is a Remote — European Union (multi-country), with travel across Europe and the Middle EastEverything happens somewhere — which is why spatial analytics is fundamental to companies trying to understand the “where” and the “why” of their business.

CARTO is the leading cloud-native location intelligence platform, trusted by data scientists, data analysts and developers from multiple National, State, and Local levels around the world to provide geospatial insights for use cases such as site selection, geomarketing, route optimization, network planning and much more.

With an exceptionally diverse team spread across the US and Europe, CARTO is changing the way companies analyze location data — making it simple to do this straight out of modern, cloud data warehouses. Redefining its category, the company has grown rapidly in recent years providing a compelling alternative to legacy GIS software.
CARTO is cloud-native by design: the platform connects directly to the data warehouses enterprises already run — Google BigQuery, Amazon Redshift, Snowflake, Databricks — so geospatial analysis happens where the customer’s data already lives , with no data movement.

And where sovereignty requires it, CARTO runs on open formats and open standards deployed on sovereign or on-premise environments. In a European market where digital sovereignty has moved from the IT backroom to the boardroom, that architecture is a decisive commercial advantage.
The opportunity European organizations are under intensifying pressure to keep sensitive data under EU jurisdictional control.

The EU Data Act, the AI Act, DORA and NIS2, the European Commission’s Cloud Sovereignty Framework, and national sovereignty initiatives have turned sovereignty into a procurement requirement — especially across government, defense, financial services, utilities, and critical infrastructure.

At the same time, a generation of legacy GIS is reaching end of life and being rebuilt for an AI-native world.
CARTO ’s architecture speaks directly to both shifts. Because analysis runs inside the customer’s own environment, on open formats and portable compute, CARTO helps customers stay AI-ready, avoid vendor lock-in, and keep control of their data. This role exists to turn that positioning into pipeline and revenue across Europe.
The role We are hiring an EU-based Business Development Manager to develop the market for CARTO ’s sovereignty proposition at the European level.

In this hunting, market-development role, you will open net-new logos, build and activate partner-led motions with cloud and sovereign-ecosystem players, and develop the public-sector and regulated-industry market where sovereignty requirements are most stringent — government, defense, national mapping and space agencies.

You will work across multiple EU countries rather than a single territory, with opportunities extending into the Middle East as the business grows. This is an individual-contributor role measured on qualified pipeline and closed ARR while you build the motion, ramping to a carried new-business quota as the segment matures.

You will report to the CRO organization and partner closely with Marketing, Solutions Engineering, Partnerships, and Legal/InfoSec.
You will
Develop the European sovereignty market for CARTO — identify, prioritize, and open net-new public-sector accounts across multiple EU countries where data sovereignty is a live buying driver.
Own the full sales cycle end to end: outbound prospecting, discovery, qualification, mission impact, RFP response — then drive deals through to close with the support of the broader team.
Build and activate partner-led pipeline with cloud data platforms (Google Cloud, AWS, Snowflake, Databricks) and the European sovereign-cloud ecosystem — including GAIA-X–aligned providers, sovereign cloud operators, and recognized boutique and large system integrators in the region — to co-sell into sovereignty-driven opportunities.
Develop the sovereign public sector market (national and state government, defense and civilian, national mapping and space agencies), navigating procurement, tenders, and framework agreements.
Position CARTO ’s architecture as a sovereignty advantage and translate EU regulation (EU Data Act, AI Act, DORA, NIS2, the Cloud Sovereignty Framework / SEAL levels) into concrete mission impact.
Treat procurement, RFPs, security questionnaires, and infosec reviews as routine parts of the motion — anticipate them, engage Legal/InfoSec early, and keep deals moving through them.
Map prospect organizations to build multi-threaded relationships with technical, commercial, and compliance decision-makers, up to and including the board-level and government sponsors who now own sovereignty decisions.
Build and maintain rigorous pipeline hygiene and forecasting in Salesforce; use Gong and the wider revenue stack to inspect and advance deals.
Feed the field back into the business — share sovereignty signals, competitive intelligence, and packaging feedback with Product, Marketing, and Partnerships to sharpen the EU go-to-market.
Travel across Europe (and occasionally the Middle East) for customer, partner, and industry events (approximately 40–50%).
You offer
We are deliberately open on background. Geospatial experience is an advantage, not a requirement — strong candidates may come from sovereign cloud, enterprise data/analytics, or public-sector and defense technology sales.
5+ year track record of success selling or developing new business for SaaS / data / analytics products in a quota-carrying role, preferably in the geospatial, data science, BI, cloud, or analytics space.
Demonstrable experience developing net-new markets or segments — you are a hunter who is comfortable creating pipeline from a standing start, not inheriting a book of business.
Working knowledge of the European digital sovereignty landscape — the EU Data Act, AI Act, DORA, NIS2, GDPR, the US CLOUD Act / FISA concerns that drive it, GAIA-X, and the EU Cloud Sovereignty Framework / SEAL assurance levels.
Public-sector go-to-market experience — familiarity with tenders, framework agreements, and procurement cycles is a strong plus.
Experience selling with and through strategic partners — cloud platforms and/or European sovereign-cloud providers, resellers, and system integrators.
Comfort with procurement-heavy sales: RFPs, security questionnaires, and infosec reviews are routine, not exceptions, and you know how to run them in parallel with the commercial motion.
A MEDDICC practitioner — formally trained and able to apply the methodology to qualify and secure complex, multi-stakeholder deals.
Understanding of the geospatial, GIS, analytics, and cloud marketspace, able to think strategically about competition, impact, and CARTO ’s role in the market.
Multi-country EU selling experience; fluent English plus at least one other relevant language (German, French, or another EU language) strongly preferred.
Proficient in the modern revenue stack: Salesforce, Gong, Apollo, LinkedIn, and others. Familiarity with consumption-based commercial models is a plus.

wellness and self-care
About Fresha
Fresha is the AI-powered operating system for the global beauty, wellness and self-care industry, connecting and powering everything from salons and barbers to spas, medspas, fitness studios and health practices.
Trusted by millions of consumers and businesses worldwide. Fresha is used by 140,000+ businesses and 450,000+ stylists and professionals worldwide, processing over 1 billion appointments to date.
The company is headquartered in London, United Kingdom, with 15 global offices located across North America, EMEA and APAC.
Fresha allows consumers to discover, book and pay for beauty and wellness appointments with local businesses via its marketplace, while beauty and wellness businesses and professionals use an all-in-one platform to manage their entire operations with an intuitive business software and financial technology solutions.
Fresha ’s ecosystem gives merchants everything they need to run their business seamlessly by facilitating appointment bookings, point-of-sale, customer records management, marketing automation, loyalty, beauty products inventory and team management.
The consumer marketplace unlocks revenue potential for partner businesses by leveraging the power of online bookings and automated marketing through mobile apps and advanced integrations with major tech brands including Instagram, Facebook and Google.

Given our exciting and progressive growth plans, we are looking for an exceptional Business Development Executive to come and join our global business.
Reporting directly to the General Manager of Europe, and working collaboratively with the Commercial team and potential partners, you will be 100% focused on bringing in new business development.
This is a great opportunity for someone looking to work in a fast-paced and changing environment, who likes to work autonomously, enjoys a challenge and wants to make an impact.
What you will be doing
KPIs - Consistently achieve sales targets
Outreach - Calling key decision-makers using phone, email & social touches with the goal of bringing on new business (in-person meetings as appropriate)
Selling - Present, promote and sell products and services through product demos to prospective and existing partners
Sales Cycle - Managing the entire sales process from prospecting to close
Partnering - Perform cost-benefit and needs analysis with existing/potential partners in order to align our solutions to their needs and business objectives
Collaboration - Work closely with other departments to ensure a seamless partner experience
Market Trends - Provide feedback about ongoing trends in the industry
Leads - Contact 100% of qualified inbound leads in a timely manner, and document all call outcomes in the CRM
Business Partnering - Serve as a lead point of contact for partners on all commercial activities
This list is not exhaustive and there may be other activities you are required to deliver.

Experience - Minimum 1 years of solid B2B sales with a track record of success
Industry - SaaS, online marketplaces, or payment platforms is highly desirable
Relationship Building - You are a true hunter and relationship builder
Organised - You can multitask, prioritise and manage time effectively
Curiosity - You are naturally curious and have a desire to continually grow and develop
Added bonus
Bi-lingual - Fluency in English and another language
Beauty & Wellness - Experience within the beauty and wellness industry
At Fresha , we value passion and potential as much as specific skills. If you're enthusiastic and eager to learn, we encourage you to apply, even if you don't meet every listed requirement. We believe in fostering growth and providing the support needed for you to excel in your role.

Screen Call - Video-call with a member from the Talent Team (30 mins)
Skills & Experience - Video/In-person interview with Team Lead (45 mins)
Presentation - Video/In-person interview with Team Lead and General Manager (Europe) (75 mins)
We aim to finalise the entire interview process and deliver feedback within 2 weeks.
Every job application received is reviewed manually by our talent team. While we strive to assess applications within 7 days, the sheer volume of talented individuals expressing interest may occasionally extend this timeframe.
Inclusive workforce
At Fresha , we are creating a culture where individuals of all backgrounds feel comfortable.
We want all Fresha people to feel included and truly empowered to contribute fully to our vision and goals. Everyone who applies will receive fair consideration for employment.
We do not discriminate based on race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, marital status, gender identity, national origin, disability, or any other applicable legally protected characteristics in the location in which the candidate is applying.
If you have any accessibility requirements that would make you more comfortable during the interview process and/or once you join, please let us know so that we can support you.

Das Unternehmen
Gerade für kleine Unternehmen muss es oft schnell gehen. Chancen warten nicht und Liquiditätsengpässe können über Nacht entstehen. Um voranzukommen und zu wachsen, brauchen KMU Finanzierung, die genauso flexibel und reaktionsschnell ist wie sie selbst.
Genau deshalb haben wir iwoca gegründet. Unsere smarte Technologie, moderne Datenanalyse und unser erstklassiger Kundenservice sorgen dafür, dass Unternehmer*innen schnell, sicher und kontrolliert handeln können - genau in den Momenten, in denen es darauf ankommt.
Wir haben bereits mehr als 150.000 Unternehmen mit über 4,5 Milliarden Euro unterstützt. Unser Team setzt alles daran, noch mehr Mittelständler*innen zum Erfolg zu verhelfen - durch besseren Zugang zu Finanzierung und zusätzliche Services, die den Geschäftsalltag einfacher machen. Unsere Mission?

Eine Million Unternehmen in ihren entscheidenden Momenten zu unterstützen und so einen nachhaltigen Beitrag zu leisten- sowohl für die Unternehmen selbst, als auch für ihr wirtschaftliches Ökosystem und die deutsche Gesamtwirtschaft.
Die Stelle
Als Account Manager*in bist du die direkte Schnittschnelle zu unseren Kund*innen und die Stimme von iwoca . Du betreust dein eigenes Portfolio von Neu- und Bestandskund*innen und unterstützt eigenverantwortlich Unternehmer*innen während unseres Kreditprozesses und der gesamten Kreditlaufzeit. Dabei legst du höchsten Wert auf Kundenservice und ermöglichst unseren Kund*innen durch deine Kommunikation die optimale Nutzung unserer Produkte.
Ein grundlegender Baustein für unseren Erfolg ist es, Kund*innen und Partner*innen von unserer Mission zu überzeugen und zu begeistern - das reicht bei unseren Kund*innen vom Frisörsalon bis zur Zahnarztpraxis und bei unseren Partner*innen von der Finanzberatung bis zu den Mitarbeiter*innen der Bankfiliale.
Wenn Sie mehr über diese Position erfahren möchten, finden Sie hier den passenden Artikel.
Zusammen arbeiten, gemeinsam wachsen: Bei uns erwartet dich ein Umfeld, in dem deine Ideen wirklich etwas bewegen. Dass unsere Kultur nicht nur auf dem Papier gut klingt, zeigt auch unser Kununu-Score von über 4,4 – ein Team, auf das man sich jeden Tag freuen kann!
Die Anforderungen

Zeigt Neugier im Umgang mit KI-Tools und Interesse daran, diese weiter zu erlernen. Du nutzt KI bereits sicher in der Praxis, um Probleme zu lösen, effizienter zu arbeiten und die Qualität deiner Arbeit zu verbessern. Dabei zeigst du ein gutes Gespür dafür, wann der Einsatz sinnvoll ist, und kannst deine Entscheidungen nachvollziehbar begründen.
Du begleitest Neukund*innen bei den Schritten für einen erfolgreichen Vertragsabschluss und übertriffst ihre Erwartungen, indem du auf individuelle Anliegen eingehst und zusammen mit Kund*innen den optimalen Einsatz für unser Produkt findest.
Du stellst sicher, dass unsere Kund*innen über ihre individuellen Möglichkeiten und unsere Produktentwicklungen rasch informiert sind.
Du verantwortest dein eigenes Portfolio an bestehenden und neuen Kund*innen.
Du baust starke, langfristige Beziehungen zu deinen Kund*innen auf und hilfst ihnen dabei, ihre Geschäftsziele mit iwoca zu erreichen.
Du hast ein gutes Verständnis der Funktionsweise von Unternehmen, einschließlich ihrer wichtigsten Risiko- und Ertragsfaktoren.
Durch dein regelmäßiges Feedback zu Rückmeldungen unserer Kund*innen, Verbesserungsmöglichkeiten unserer Prozesse oder neue Angebote unserer Wettbewerber nimmst du aktiv an der Weiterentwicklung von iwoca teil.

Wir suchen Menschen, die smart, bodenständig und motiviert sind und sich ständig weiterentwickeln wollen. Um in dieser Rolle erfolgreich zu sein, trifft im Idealfall Folgendes auf Dich zu:
Du hast Spaß an der Kommunikation mit Kund*innen und lebst “Customer Centricity". Für dich ist es die größte Motivation, Erfolge mit unseren Kund*innen zu erzielen.
Du hast eine abgeschlossene kaufmännische Ausbildung / betriebswirtschaftliches Studium und kannst mit relevanter Berufserfahrung im Kundenservice punkten (Erfahrungen im Bankenumfeld oder einem Fintech sind ein Plus).
Du bist ein echter Teamplayer und kannst das Team bei bereichsübergreifenden Projekten unterstützen.
Du bist hochmotiviert, organisiert, vertriebsorientiert und hast eine ‘Hands-on-Mentalität’.
Du hast exzellente Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und ausgezeichnete Deutschkenntnisse(C1/C2). Außerdem bringst du Englischkenntnisse mit, sodass Meetings in unserem internationalen Team kein Problem für dich sind.
Eine selbstständige, teamorientierte und zuverlässige Arbeitsweise ist für dich selbstverständlich.
Du besitzt die Fähigkeit, "über den Tellerrand hinauszudenken", um Optimierungsvorschläge zu unseren Produkten, Systemen und Prozessen zu machen.
Das Gehalt
Wir rechnen mit einem Gehalt zwischen 41.000 € und 50.000 € für diese Stelle. Uns ist es jedoch wichtig, dich fair zu bezahlen, also gib in deiner Bewerbung unbedingt deine Gehaltsvorstellungen an. Wir vergleichen Gehälter regelmäßig mit den marktüblichen Sätzen und führen zusätzlich vierteljährliche Performance- und Gehaltsreviews durch.
Die Kultur
Bei iwoca gewinnt die beste Idee. Unsere Kultur basiert auf eigenständigem Denken, dem Hinterfragen von Annahmen und faktenbasierten Entscheidungen. Wir legen großen Wert auf Lernen und Weiterentwicklung und geben dir die Freiheit, dich in die Richtung zu entwickeln, in der du am wirkungsvollsten bist.
Wir sind ein Technologieunternehmen und glauben an das Potenzial von KI, uns schneller und besser arbeiten zu lassen. Wir schaffen die Voraussetzungen dafür, dass alle im Team jederzeit Zugriff auf die besten Modelle haben – und dass diese Modelle mit unseren Daten arbeiten können. Gleichzeitig unterstützen wir dich dabei, den Umgang mit neuen Tools zu lernen und dich mit ihnen weiterzuentwickeln.
Die Büros
Wir geben uns viel Mühe, iwoca zu einem großartigen Arbeitsplatz zu machen:
Büros in Berlin, Frankfurt, London und Leeds mit reichlich Snacks und Getränken
Veranstaltungen und Clubs: Von Laufgruppen und Padel bis hin zu monatlichen Ping-Pong- und Billard-Turnieren

Ein smartes, motiviertes und internationales Team (wir vertreten über 35 verschiedene Nationalitäten) mit einem unbändigen Growth-Mindset
26 Urlaubstage pro Jahr, plus ein freier Tag an deinem Geburtstag, die Möglichkeit, bis zu fünf Urlaubstage zu kaufen oder zu verkaufen, sowie unbegrenzter (unbezahlter) Urlaub
Ein 1-monatiges, voll bezahltes Sabbatical nach 4 Jahren bei iwoca
Direkter Zugang zur Unterstützung von zertifizierten Psycholog*innen mit unserem Partner OpenUp für Teammitglieder, die emotionale oder mentale Unterstützung brauchen
Zuschuss zur Fitnessstudio-Mitgliedschaft: 25 € für Fit711 oder den Urban Sports Club
30 € Zuschuss zum Deutschlandticket
Betriebliche Altersvorsorge über Canada Life
Top-Standorte: In Frankfurt direkt in der Innenstadt, in Berlin mitten im Prenzlauer Berg
Ein bezahlter Tag für Freiwilligenarbeit, an dem du eine gemeinnützige Organisation deiner Wahl unterstützen kannst
Voll ausgestattete Kühlschränke in unseren Büros mit allem, was das Herz begehrt: von gesunden Snacks bis hin zu Nervennahrung für den ganzen Tag

Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data.

Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on.

PadSplit is hiring a Host Account Manager of Emerging Products to serve as the dedicated strategic partner and primary point of contact for a portfolio of PadSplit hosts. This is a newly created role at the heart of our Host Success model, designed to shift how we support all hosts from reactive problem-solving to proactive, relationship-driven account management.
You will own the full host relationship from activation through long-term retention. But owning the relationship means more than managing check-ins and reviewing dashboards.

It means being a trusted partner and the person your hosts call when something goes wrong, someone who knows the platform, the policies, and the fee structures well enough to provide clear answers on the spot.

You will be measured on the outcomes that matter most: your response times, occupancy performance, host satisfaction, churn reduction, and portfolio retention. This role is critical to ensuring every host in your book of business has what they need to thrive on the platform, and that they feel it.

s.h: The Person We Are Looking For
s.t:
We are looking for a relationship-first operator who leads with data, follows through with hustle, and knows the product, policies, and PadSplit member outcomes well enough to earn a host’s trust in the first conversation. You are proactive by nature, the kind of person who spots a problem in a dashboard before a host ever has to call about it.

You are also comfortable in the reactive moments: a confused host on the phone about a payout deduction, a complex situation involving a member that requires judgment and empathy in equal measure, a policy question that does not have a clean answer. You handle those moments with the same professionalism you bring to your scheduled portfolio reviews.
You understand that being a trusted partner requires genuine knowledge. You do not escalate everything, and you do not guess. You build the platform and policy fluency to be the person who actually resolves the issue, and you know when escalation is the right call. You believe in PadSplit’s mission and understand what it means to work in the affordable housing space, where the stakes for both hosts and members are real.

Own and manage a dedicated portfolio of PadSplit hosts, serving as their primary named point of contact for support ticket escalation and resolution, policy adherence and understanding, and overall portfolio direction
Provide the right information at the right time, becoming a partner and strategic advisor of PadSplit
Build proactive, trust-based relationships that reduce churn and increase host lifetime value.
Conduct regular performance check-ins, including structured reviews aligned to host goals and PadSplit benchmarks.
Drive host accountability on key metrics including attainable occupancy, bookability flags, rejection rates, move-in ratings, and member retention.
Partner with hosts on portfolio growth, including conversations about adding new properties and expanding their PadSplit footprint.
Serve as the host’s internal advocate, surfacing feedback and trends to product, operations, and leadership.

Maintain deep working knowledge of PadSplit’s platform, fee structures, payout mechanics, and host-facing policies, with the ability to explain decisions clearly and confidently.
Serve as a knowledgeable, trusted point of contact for hosts navigating financial questions, policy inquiries, and operational challenges.
Apply PadSplit policies thoughtfully, explaining both the “what” and the “why” in a way that builds understanding and trust rather than resentment.
Guide hosts on pricing strategy, occupancy optimization, listing quality, rejection rate management, and platform best practices using both data and platform knowledge.
Monitor host and property performance using PadSplit’s data tools, identifying risks and opportunities before they become problems.

Lead an intro call for every new host in your portfolio, establishing the relationship and setting expectations from day one.
Guide new hosts from the beginning, covering pricing, room standards, rejection rate drivers, and mission-critical success requirements.
Prepare hosts for their first members: responsiveness standards, room readiness expectations, and move-in experience requirements.
Educate new hosts on member outcome drivers including safety compliance, pricing discipline, and platform behaviors that directly improve member, host and company outcomes.

Navigate complex, nuanced host situations that require investigation, sound judgment, and fair resolution.
Escalate and coordinate resolution of issues that require cross-functional support, working with member support, trust and safety, payments, and legal teams where appropriate.
Manage emotionally charged conversations with empathy, composure, and directness, holding firm on policy while maintaining the relationship.
Document ticket details and resolutions accurately, maintaining clear records across all host interactions.
Identify patterns in host concerns and flag systemic issues to inform process, policy, or product improvements.

Contribute to the development of scalable playbooks, talk tracks, macro responses, and best practices as this function matures.
Participate in weekly team syncs to share what is working, surface friction points, and iterate on the program in real time.

s.h: Here’s What You’ll Need to Be Successful
s.t:
Account Management or Customer Success Background: 3+ years of account management, customer success, or high-touch client relationship experience. Background in real estate, property management, hospitality, or a platform-based marketplace is strongly preferred.
Platform and Policy Fluency: Ability and willingness to develop deep working knowledge of PadSplit’s product, fee structures, and policies, and to use that knowledge in live host conversations.
Proactive Portfolio Management: Proven ability to manage a large book of relationships with a proactive, not reactive, approach. You spot the problem before the host calls.
Data-Driven Communication: Comfortable using data to tell a story and drive a conversation. You can translate performance metrics into clear, actionable guidance a host can act on today.
Critical Thinking and Sound Judgment: Ability to analyze incomplete or conflicting information, apply policies thoughtfully in nuanced scenarios, and arrive at fair, defensible decisions.
Empathetic Directness: Skill in balancing compassion with clarity, especially when delivering difficult or unpopular outcomes. You hold firm on policy while making the host feel heard.
Strong Communication: Clear, confident written and verbal communication tailored to diverse audiences. You build trust quickly and handle difficult conversations without escalating unnecessarily.
Organization and Follow-Through: Highly organized with the ability to prioritize across a large portfolio without dropping the ball on high-value or high-risk relationships.
Mission Alignment: Genuine belief in PadSplit’s mission and an understanding of what it means to operate in the affordable housing space.
Growth Mindset: Motivated by the idea of building something new and improving it as you go. This function is being built from the ground up and you will help shape it.
